name: test_gaps
about: Running jumps across gaps, one block of lanes per speed band (standing, 3.0 m/s held, and 3.6, 5.0 and 7.2 m/s from full stick over the run-up that builds them, plus 5 % and 1 m for the start), each landing height from +1 to -3 m at Comfortable and at Max (1 cm inside each) and 10 cm past Clearly out (expect fail). Roofs 4 m wide, take-offs at 0 over a pit 5 m down, landings 6 m deep. Up 1 m before the edge (standing: at it); +1 m landings add the coil.
